description: Open roles for one company token, looked up on the three public applicant-tracking job APIs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby). Each job says which system it came from; a system that has no board for that token is reported as not found. Title, location, team or department, posted time, apply link. Salary is given only when the feed provides it, which these feeds mostly do not. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

company.description: Company token used on the ATS sites, e.g. airbnb

limit.description: How many jobs in total, 1 to 100 (default 20)
